jobs.title: SafePoint Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
With a network of nearly 200 branches, Loomis armored transportation, cash management centers, and cash inventory vaults keep cash flowing throughout financial institutions and retail businesses across the US. Loomis prides itself on providing employees with opportunities for career advancement and job satisfaction. In fact, many of our company’s managers, vice presidents, and corporate executives started out in the branches as driver/guards and tellers. Our work can be challenging, but the thousands who have stayed with our company for decades will tell you that if you have the desire to learn and the drive to succeed, Loomis is the place to be. Come join our team!
  
  

**Job Overview:** This position is responsible for developing Loomis’ SafePoint product and solution configuration and managing onboarding and implementation processes for specified clients’ implementations, reporting to the Implementation Specialist Manager. This role will also manage SafePoint logistics, equipment inventory coordination, vendor ordering, and planning alignment to ensure the right devices, parts, and support materials are available for each implementation timeline.
  
  

**Accountabilities:**  

* Accountable for end\-to\-end implementation, resource scheduling, stakeholder communication, maintaining the implementation process, and ensuring timely, professional installation, implementation, and training of the SafePoint Solution.
* Engage with company and clients in a positive, professional, and proactive manner.
* Study and understand the product offering and all aspects of the solution’s implementation project plan, and become a Subject Matter Expert on SafePoint and all of its applications and permutations.
* Use all existing resources and seek additional avenues to improve your abilities and value to the company and its clients, working on personal development according to the guidelines and expectations set in your employee development plan.
* Actively ensure you meet managers' and clients' expectations, driving continuous improvement, process efficiency, and customer (internal and external) satisfaction.
* Utilize sound Project Management skills and capabilities to deliver a comprehensive and problem\-free solution implementation.
* Utilize critical communication skills and influence management techniques to motivate co\-workers, clients, and end\-user customers for the successful completion of the projects under your control.
* Coordinate SafePoint equipment logistics, including device allocation, shipment timing, delivery tracking, installation readiness, and inventory availability across implementation projects.
* Work closely with Planning, Operations, Vendors, and service partners to forecast upcoming SafePoint deployment needs and align ordering schedules with client implementation dates.
* Support vendor ordering processes by monitoring purchase requests, order status, delivery commitments, backorders, and escalation needs to prevent implementation delays.
* Maintain visibility into SafePoint implementation inventory, including units on hand, units committed to projects, units in transit, and inventory risks requiring management attention.
* Continually evaluate the implementation process, looking for better, faster, more profitable ways to sell, install, and operate the product.
* Establish and maintain exceptional client relationships at a peer level and explore additional ways that Loomis can provide value.
* Actively develop and improve upon client relationship management and engagement skills.
* Vendor management: continue to push vendors to support customers professionally and efficiently.
* Special Projects as assigned by the Product Management team.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Primary Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree or Technical institute degree/certificate in Business, Computer Science, IS, or other related field, preferred.
* Equivalent work experience in lieu of degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of operational process improvement experience required.
* Proven Project management and Quality systems implementation experience is required.
* Must have excellent communication skills.
* Ability to travel up to 10% is required.
* Ability to influence management is required.
* Experience coordinating logistics, inventory tracking, vendor ordering, or supply planning is strongly preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple implementation schedules, equipment requirements, and vendor follow\-ups simultaneously.


Loomis is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.

jobs.title: Lead Implementation Shared Services Ops - Elevate Implementation
jobs.description:
Paylocity is an award\-winning provider of cloud\-based HR and payroll software solutions, offering the most complete platform for the modern workforce. The company has become one of the fastest\-growing HCM software providers worldwide by offering an intuitive, easy\-to\-use product suite that helps businesses automate and streamline HR and payroll processes, attract and retain talent, and build a strong workplace culture.


While traditional HR and payroll providers automate basic HR processes such as payroll and benefits administration, Paylocity goes further by developing tools that HR and businesses need to compete for talent and deliver against the expectations of the modern workforce.


We give our employees what they need to succeed, including great benefits and perks! We offer medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and a 401(k) match, as well as perks that support you, your family, and your finances. And if it’s career development you desire, we provide that, too! At Paylocity, people matter most and have always been at the heart of our business.


Help our award\-winning technology company run effectively as you take on big challenges and find solutions with a position in Operations. Use your problem\-solving skills to shape the way others see Paylocity. Launch your career with us!

**In\-Office:** This is a 100% in\-office role based at our Schaumburg,, IL/Rochester, NY/ Lake Mary, FL locations. Remote or hybrid work is not available for this position. Candidates must be able to work on\-site five days per week during designated work hours.

**Position Overview**


The Implementation Shared Services Team Lead will provide leadership, coaching, training and mentoring to team members to ensure all critical aspects of the job are met appropriately. The Team Lead will provide feedback to team members on areas of improvement and identify areas of success. The Team Lead is instrumental in assisting Implementation Managers by providing


feedback on staff performance, system and personnel issues, and to identify actions to be taken to improve departmental and implementation success. The Team Lead must be able to identify and effectively communicate areas of training improvements and common performance deficits as well as offer praise and positive promotion of a job well done.

**Primary Responsibilities**


The below represents the primary duties of the position, others may be assigned as needed. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

* Supervision of the operations for their designated team
* Supervising the work of their assigned group on a day to day basis which may include delegation of work assignments to various team members
* Provide training and assist with coaching and development of new and existing team members
* Facilitate business or team update communications through regularly occurring meetings, 1:1s or team huddles
* Are expected to provide input and recommendations to managers in the areas of performance management, promotional opportunities, employee terminations and performance issues which are generally followed by the manager
* Developing and collaborating with management on best practices and ways to improve the team’s performance
* Handling escalated client/departmental issues and deciding what, if anything, to do or offer to achieve resolution
* Take appropriate action on employee issues related to job performance and professional conduct, with assistance from and in collaboration with the Managers
* Conduct quality assessments and evaluations; meet weekly with teams to review assignments and performance metrics
* Provide resolution and assistance to clients who have escalated concerns. This will require communication with other members of Paylocity leadership including Executives and C Level Client contacts
* Identify areas of improvement and make recommendations for supplemental training for team members
* Lead and facilitate training for new and existing team members
* Create, update and maintain new and existing training and reference documentation
* Act as technical resource to team members and answer inquiries as needed
* Manage incoming workload via queue monitoring, organization, and communication with Implementation Managers, Team Leads, Consultants and Data Conversion
* Update Tools and internal training documentation as necessary
* All other duties as assigned

**Education and Experience**

* Minimum three years experience in Payroll Implementation required
* Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience
* Previous Implementation and/or Implementation internal support experience is strongly recommended
* Previous management experience a plus
* Previous experience and understanding of Paylocity’s tools preferred
* Ability to mentor/coach peers
* Strong problem solving/analytical ability
* Proficiency in MS office with strong Excel skills
* Physical requirements
* Ability to sit for extended periods: The role requires sitting at a desk or workstation for long periods, typically 7\-8 hours a day.
* Use of computer and phone systems: The employee must be able to operate a computer, use phone systems, and type. This includes using multiple software programs and inquiries simultaneously

**Paylocity is an** **equal\-opportunity** **employer.** Paylocity is committed to the full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, compensate, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. At Paylocity, we believe diversity makes us better.


We embrace and encourage our employees’ differences in age, culture, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion or spiritual belief, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We actively cultivate these differences through our employee resource groups (ERGs), employee experiences, perspectives, talents, and approaches to drive innovation in the software and services we provide our customers.


We comply with federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. To request reasonable accommodation in the job application or interview process, please contact accessibility@paylocity.com. This email address is exclusively designated for such requests, aligning with federal and state disability laws. Please do not send resumes to this email address, as they will be removed.


The base pay range for this position is $63,600\- $90,800/yr; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for an annual bonus and restricted stock unit grant based on individual performance in addition to a full range of benefits . This information is provided per the relevant state and local pay transparency laws for the location in which this position will be performed. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via www.paylocity.com/careers.

jobs.title: EMR Analyst II **Optime and Anesthesia** Remote
jobs.description:
**Why work at TidalHealth?**


Looking for a rewarding place to work? Choose TidalHealth, which now includes three hospitals – TidalHealth Peninsula Regional in Salisbury, Maryland; TidalHealth Nanticoke in Seaford, Delaware; and TidalHealth Atlantic in Berlin, Maryland. All three hospitals are “A” rated by Leapfrog Hospital Safety Guide, and the facilities have received numerous other honors.


TidalHealth is regularly adding new practices to grow our offerings in specialty and subspecialty services. These include neurosurgery, cardiothoracic surgery, joint replacement, emergency/trauma care, comprehensive cancer care, wound care, clinical trials and research, and more. TidalHealth is also home to a growing graduate medical education program to prepare the next generation of physician specialists.


Located on the beautiful Delmarva Peninsula, close to the beach, becoming part of Team TidalHealth also offers an ideal opportunity for work\-life balance. Take advantage of our tuition assistance and scholarship programs to grow both personally and professionally.


**EMR Analyst II Position Summary**


The EMR Analyst II provides analytical expertise in the development and implementation of system\-related clinical, access, revenue cycle, decision support and quality improvement applications. He / she will support new project development including system analysis, planning and preparation. Develop, support and maintain documentation and procedures as needed. Provide training to other IT staff and user clients as appropriate. Provides product function, design, and build expertise (obtains EMR module certification) and experience needed for successful product implementation. Supports all project team members with application and information systems knowledge. The Application Analyst is a member of the team of primary resources dedicated to designing, building, testing, and activating the application database. Develops and maintains models and documentation of business and system requirements and configures system accordingly. Documents and maintains all required system design and build documents. Contributes to preparation of testing scripts and materials and performs unit, system, and integrated testing tasks. Works with training team to develop application specific training curriculums and materials. Provides expertise and experience to the development of activation plans, application activation tasks, and production environment readiness. Logs, tracks, and resolves issues as well as any software code modifications or enhancements


**EMR Analyst II Position Requirements**


Required License and/or Certification


* Has EPIC certification in assigned modules


Education


* Bachelor’s degree preferred. Extensive work experience may be considered in lieu of educational requirements on a case\-by\-case basis.


Experience


* 3 years of relevant work experience in healthcare or similar fields.


**EMR Analyst II Work Schedule**


* Day shift, Monday through Friday with call. Overtime may be required.
* Expected to respond in the event of a disaster.


**EMR Analyst II Benefits**


* At TidalHealth, full\-time employees working at least 72 hours per pay period, part\-time employees working at least 36 hours per pay period and part\-time employees working at least 30 hours or more on weekends only are eligible for benefits.
* Benefits include medical, prescription, vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, disability insurance plans, life insurance, paid time off plans, retirement plans, tuition assistance, employee assistance, and access to on\-site childcare and a credit union.

  



  

Location: TidalHealth · Information Services\-TidalHealth Peninsula Regional  

Schedule: Full Time, Monday \- Friday, 8:00\-4:30pm

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Circadia Health**



Circadia Health is a growth\-stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior\-care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines:


* Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical\-grade accuracy
* Native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance
* Enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care\-coordination, billing, and compliance workflows

Today, our technology touches 40,000\+ post\-acute patients daily across skilled\-nursing, home\-health, and home\-care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA.

**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Implementation and Support**


* Lead on\-site implementation of Circadia's monitoring platform in SNFs, from device installation through go\-live, integrating it into existing care routines rather than adding a parallel process.
* Assess each facility before rollout: shift patterns, unit layout, staffing model, EHR workflow, and connectivity constraints.
* Build and execute the facility implementation plan with clear owners, dates, and dependencies, keeping it current as conditions change.
* Serve as first\-line support after launch: troubleshoot devices and connectivity, resolve staff questions, and escalate product issues with enough detail for Engineering to act.
* Track device uptime and utilization by facility, unit, and shift, and flag gaps before the customer does.


**Training and Adoption**


* Deliver training to clinical and frontline staff across all shifts, including nights and weekends, where adoption gaps usually live.
* Tailor content and delivery to the audience. CNAs, nurses, DONs, unit managers, and facility IT each need a different version.
* Build and maintain training materials and a knowledge base that hold up after you leave the building.
* Identify the behavioral reason adoption is lagging rather than defaulting to another session, and retrain where retraining is the actual fix.
* Develop facility champions and super\-users so competence survives staff turnover.


**Relationship Management and Collaboration**


* Build working trust with facility teams at every level, from the floor to the administrator, so staff surface issues early.
* Coordinate with in\-house care teams and remote clinical providers so the customer experiences one program, not several.
* Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings, contributing implementation insight and ensuring device data is used inside patient care plans.
* Partner with Customer Success, Clinical, Support, and Engineering to unblock deployments, and own customer\-facing communication while a dependency is open.
* Hand off to Customer Success with a documented account state: utilization baseline, stakeholder map, and open risks.


**Quality Improvement and Compliance**


* Feed field evidence to Product and Engineering: failure modes, workflow friction, and what staff actually do with the product.
* Ensure all activity complies with regulatory standards and patient safety guidelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of implementation activity, staff education, and device functionality checks, aligned to organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Follow facility protocols on HIPAA, infection control, and site access.

**Qualifications**
------------------



**Must\-have**


* Bachelor's degree in business, operations, healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience in a healthcare setting.
* Comfort operating inside healthcare environments, particularly skilled nursing facilities, with working knowledge of nursing workflows, shift structure, and floor dynamics.
* Clear, confident verbal and written communication with the ability to train and hold a room of clinical staff.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility quickly with audiences ranging from CNAs to facility administrators.
* Practical problem\-solving: you diagnose the cause on site rather than escalating it as\-is.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, managing your own schedule, follow\-up, and commitments across multiple facilities at once.
* Organizational rigor with project tracking tools such as Monday.com. Nothing lives only in your head.
* Willingness to travel up to 75%, including early mornings and occasional overnight shift coverage.


**Preferred**


* Experience implementing healthcare technology, remote patient monitoring, or telehealth services in provider settings.
* Clinical background or license (RN, LPN, RT, CNA) or direct post\-acute operations experience.
* Experience training frontline staff in high\-turnover environments.


As a full\-time **Implementation Specialist,** you will be employed by Circadia Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full\-time position is $75,000 \- $100,000\. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job\-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.



Annual salary is only one part of an employee's total compensation package at Circadia Health. We also offer:


* Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays
* Impact: your work will influence care decisions for tens of thousands of seniors every day.
* Culture: hard\-working, mission\-driven, and collaborative — with weekly and monthly social events like yoga, beach bonfires, and Wednesday/Friday team lunches.

Circadia Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
**City/State**


Virginia Beach, VA**Work Shift**


First (Days)**Overview:**

**Overview**
============


Sentara Health is now hiring an **IT Director, Clinical Systems**. This position will work remotely but must live within a drivable distance to Virginia Beach. The IT Director, Clinical Systems provides strategic, operational, and people leadership for the technology solutions supporting hospital\-based clinical operations.  



  

This role is accountable for the performance, optimization, governance, and future direction of the clinical systems portfolio supporting Pharmacy, Laboratory Services, Inpatient Physicians, Inpatient Nursing, Emergency Department, Research, Infection Prevention, Capacity Management, Throughput, and other hospital\-based clinical service lines.  



  

The Director serves as the primary IT executive partner for operational and clinical leaders, ensuring technology investments align with organizational priorities, improve patient outcomes, enhance caregiver experience, and support operational excellence.

**Education**
=============

* Bachelor's degree (Preferred)


or

* *At least 8 years of relevant management experience in lieu of bachelor's degree*

**Experience**
==============

* At least 5 years of relevant experience (Required)
* Hands on working experience with EPIC (Required)

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* **Strategic Leadership \& Business Partnership**
	+ Develop and execute the technology strategy and roadmap for hospital\-based clinical systems.
	+ Serve as the primary IT partner for executive, physician, nursing, pharmacy, laboratory, research, and operational leaders.
	+ Align technology investments and priorities with organizational strategic goals, regulatory requirements, and clinical initiatives.
	+ Drive adoption of innovative technologies, automation, analytics, and workflow improvements that improve patient care and operational performance.
* **Clinical Portfolio Oversight**
	+ Provide executive oversight for the clinical systems portfolio supporting:
		- Pharmacy
		- Laboratory Services
		- Inpatient Physicians
		- Inpatient Nursing
		- Emergency Department
		- Research
		- Infection Prevention
		- Capacity Management and Throughput
		- Clinical Logistics
		- Additional hospital\-based clinical departments and services
	+ Ensure systems are reliable, optimized, integrated, and aligned with business and clinical objectives.
	+ Establish portfolio roadmaps, modernization plans, and lifecycle management strategies.
* **Operations, Optimization \& Service Delivery**
	+ Lead ongoing optimization of clinical workflows and supporting technologies.
	+ Ensure effective support, maintenance, monitoring, and performance management of clinical applications.
	+ Drive improvements in operational metrics such as patient throughput, clinician efficiency, patient safety, quality outcomes, and user satisfaction.
	+ Oversee production support, issue resolution, and major incident management activities.
* **Governance, Prioritization \& Change Management**
	+ Lead governance processes for intake, prioritization, demand management, and resource allocation.
	+ Establish and maintain change control processes that balance operational stability with business agility.
	+ Facilitate cross\-functional decision\-making regarding competing priorities and resource constraints.
	+ Serve as the escalation point for highly complex clinical, operational, and technology issues.
* **Program \& Project Execution**
	+ Oversee major clinical systems initiatives, implementations, upgrades, integrations, and optimization efforts.
	+ Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and achieve intended business outcomes.
	+ Coordinate activities across business, clinical, operational, and technical teams.
	+ Manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations across the portfolio.
* **Financial \& Vendor Management**
	+ Develop and manage operating and capital budgets for the clinical systems portfolio.
	+ Ensure effective stewardship of financial resources and technology investments.
	+ Lead vendor relationships, contract negotiations, service reviews, and performance management.
	+ Support business case development and strategic investment planning.
* **Regulatory Compliance, Security \& Risk Management**
	+ Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare regulations, organizational policies, and security requirements.
	+ Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, privacy, and risk management teams to protect clinical and patient data.
	+ Maintain disaster recovery, business continuity, system resiliency, and access governance processes.
	+ Identify and mitigate operational, regulatory, and technology risks.
* **Leadership \& Talent Development**
	+ Lead, coach, and develop a team of managers, analysts, and technical professionals.
	+ Establish clear goals, accountability measures, and performance expectations.
	+ Build leadership bench strength and succession plans.
	+ Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* **Executive Communication \& Stakeholder Management**
	+ Present portfolio status, risks, investment needs, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
	+ Build trusted relationships with physicians, nursing leadership, department directors, and operational partners.


Sentara is currently reviewing market compensation for this role. Our Talent Acquisition team will be able to share more specific information during the recruiting process. **Benefits: Caring For Your Family and Your Career**

* Medical, Dental, Vision plans
* Adoption, Fertility and Surrogacy Reimbursement up to $10,000
* Paid Time Off and Sick Leave
* Paid Parental \& Family Caregiver Leave
* Emergency Backup Care
* Long\-Term, Short\-Term Disability, and Critical Illness plans
* Life Insurance
* 401k/403B with Employer Match
* Tuition Assistance – $5,250/year and discounted educational opportunities through Guild Education
* Student Debt Pay Down – $10,000

**Sentara Independence** provides quality outpatient services to the surrounding community. The facility includes an ambulance\-accessible emergency room that is supported by board\-certified physicians. Sentara Independence houses state\-of\-the\-art medical equipment and highly\-skilled physicians and staff. Sentara Independence is now an extension of the quality services at Sentara Virginia Beach General Hospital including advanced imaging and physical therapy.

**Sentara Health is an equal opportunity employer** and prides itself on the diversity and inclusiveness of its close to an almost 30,000\-member workforce. Diversity, inclusion, and belonging is a guiding principle of the organization to ensure its workforce reflects the communities it serves.

  

In support of our mission “to improve health every day,” this is a tobacco\-free environment.

Alabama, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Kansas, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Minnesota, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin, and Wyoming.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst I - RFID Solutions & Field Implementation
jobs.description:
**Position****Summary:**



The Operations Analyst I supports the implementation, optimization, and ongoing success of RFID\-enabled inventory management solutions, including Grab and Go storeroom deployments. This entry\-level role works closely with customers, operations teams, project managers, and implementation specialists to install, configure, validate, and support RFID inventory systems at customer locations.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, customer\-focused, and able to travel extensively in support of customer implementations and operational initiatives. This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in supply chain operations, inventory management, RFID technology, and field implementation practices.


### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**


#### **RFID Storeroom Implementation Support**


* Assist with the installation and deployment of RFID\-enabled Grab and Go storeroom solutions at customer sites.
* Support project teams during customer onboarding, site assessments, inventory setup, and go\-live activities.
* Configure, test, and verify RFID hardware, readers, cabinets, kiosks, networking equipment, and supporting software.
* Conduct system testing, validation, and troubleshooting activities to support successful implementation.
* Assist with inventory loading, item labeling, and RFID tag application activities.
* Document installation activities and implementation outcomes.


#### **Customer****Support****\&****Training**


* Serve as an on\-site resource during implementation activities and customer launches.
* Provide basic training to customer personnel on system operation, inventory processes, and best practices.
* Document customer requirements, operational challenges, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Respond to customer inquiries and escalate technical issues to appropriate support resources as needed.


#### **Data****Analysis****\&****Reporting**


* Collect, review, and analyze inventory, utilization, and operational data.
* Monitor implementation metrics and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assist in the development of reports, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to measure adoption and system performance.
* Identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities to improve inventory accuracy and operational efficiency.


#### **Operational****Excellence**


* Support the standardization of implementation processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Maintain accurate project records, implementation checklists, and site documentation.
* Assist with inventory audits, cycle counts, and reconciliation activities.
* Support customer inventory management programs by helping ensure inventory accuracy, replenishment effectiveness, and compliance with established operational standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to improve operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and solution performance.
* Adhere to company safety policies, customer site requirements, and operational procedures.
  


  

Requirements:
### **Job Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
* Ability to learn and apply new technologies, software applications, and operational processes.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated customer service and relationship management skills.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel as required.


### **Travel Requirements:**


* Frequent travel to customer locations throughout the United States is required.
* Travel is expected to be approximately 50% to 75% but may vary based on project schedules, customer requirements, and business needs.
* Ability to work flexible schedules, including early mornings, evenings, and occasional weekends, as business needs require.


### **Physical Requirements:**


* Ability to lift, carry, and move inventory, equipment, and materials up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and climb for extended periods during site implementations and customer visits.
* Ability to work in warehouse, manufacturing, industrial, and customer environments.
* Ability to operate a computer, mobile device, and related technology equipment for extended periods.

jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist, Heavy Duty Automotive**  

**Location:** Remote (U.S.\-based) Preference given to CA, TX, and FL  

**Department:** Customer Success  

**Reports to:** Chief Customer Officer  

**Starting Pay Range: $90k \- $105k/yr**  

  

The Arcadium platform is the premier sales, CRM and vehicle management solution in the heavy\-duty truck market. As part of Work Truck Solutions, Arcadium has a culture that combines strong leadership, collaboration, and fun, with incredible growth opportunities for our employees in a fast\-paced work environment providing employee engagement, recognition, and development. Our software company is committed to innovation in the rapidly changing heavy\-duty vehicle market.  

Our vision and culture allow employees to be recognized as thought leaders and thrive in their careers.  

  

In addition to the job responsibilities and requirements, the following are essential to be a successful member of our team:  

**Curiosity**: you seek knowledge, ask questions, and look for answers; you’re proactive and  

engaged  

**Perseverance**: you hit a delay; you know this is your moment to figure things out and to shine **Innovation**: you want to make things better, solve the puzzle, create something new  

**Flexibility**: there’s a new opportunity; you’re ready to flip the script, grow and adapt  

  

This role owns the successful launch of Arcadium for **newly signed heavy\-duty truck, trailer, equipment, and bus franchise dealers**, as well as the rollout of new functionality for existing customers. Arcadium’s primary product is a market\-specific customer relationship management (CRM) platform built for how heavy\-duty franchise dealers operate. The **Implementation Specialist** is responsible for **on\-time implementation, customer satisfaction, and platform utilization** for each assigned implementation \- assessing each dealership’s needs, configuring the platform to meet them, and training dealership teams on best\-practice use so they see value from day one.  

  

This role sits at the intersection of the customer, the product, and the internal teams that deliver it. The Implementation Specialist coordinates the contributions of Support, Development, Product, Sales, and Account Management to keep every implementation on track, and continuously looks for ways to improve the quality and efficiency of the implementation process, including recommending process and product changes. This is an individual contributor role reporting to Customer Success leadership; it requires strong project management, consultative, and training abilities, and up to 25% travel for on\-site dealer implementations and training.  

**Key** **Responsibilities**
============================

* + **Needs Assessment \& Discovery:** Lead structured needs assessments with dealer principals, general managers, and department leaders to document current workflows, lead and customer management processes, data, integrations, and goals across the dealership’s new and used sales, parts, and service departments.
* + **System Configuration:** Translate assessment findings into a configuration plan and set up the Arcadium platform \- users, roles and permissions, rooftops and departments, workflows, lead sources, templates, data imports, and integrations \- to fit each dealership’s operations and Arcadium best practices.
	+ **Implementation Project Management:** Own each implementation from kickoff through go\-live, building and maintaining the project plan, milestones, and timeline; managing risks and dependencies; and keeping customer stakeholders and internal teams informed of status.
	+ **Training \& Best\-Practice Adoption:** Deliver role\-based training, remotely and on site, to dealership users and leadership, focused on best\-practice use of the platform so teams adopt it quickly and consistently.
	+ **New Functionality for Existing Customers:** Plan and implement new products, features, and expanded use \- such as additional rooftops, departments, or modules \- for existing customers, partnering with Account Managers and Sales to drive adoption and utilization.
	+ **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Coordinate the activities of Support, Development, Product, Sales, and Account Management that contribute to each implementation \- scoping requests, tracking deliverables, escalating blockers, and ensuring a clean handoff to Account Management after go\-live.
	+ **Process \& Product Improvement:** Identify recurring issues, bottlenecks, and gaps in the implementation process and recommend process, tooling, and product changes that improve quality, shorten time\-to\-value, and increase efficiency.
	+ **Field Engagement:** Travel up to 25% to conduct on\-site activities at dealer locations, and participate in company\-sponsored and industry events such as dealer association meetings and trade shows.
	+ **Documentation \& Reporting:** Maintain accurate, real\-time implementation status, configuration records, training completion, and customer feedback within the company CRM system, and contribute to implementation playbooks, templates, and training materials.
	+ **Market Expertise:** Develop deep expertise in the Arcadium platform and our full portfolio of solutions and share information and context internally \- including customer feedback regarding dealership operations and customer needs.


**What Success Looks** **Like**
===============================

* + **On\-Time Implementation:** Implementations and new functionality rollouts delivered on schedule against agreed milestones and go\-live dates.
	+ **Customer Satisfaction:** High satisfaction scores and positive feedback from dealership stakeholders throughout implementation and at go\-live.
* + **Platform Utilization:** Strong user engagement, feature usage, and workflow adoption across implemented dealerships in the weeks and months after go\-live.
	+ **Continuous Improvement:** Process and product recommendations that measurably improve implementation quality and efficiency.


**Requirements**
================

* + 3\+ years of experience in software implementation, onboarding, customer success, or account management within the heavy\-duty technology market, with a history of **delivering implementations on time and driving user adoption**.
	+ Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation projects, balancing timelines, priorities, and stakeholders.
	+ Heavy duty industry experience is required, in one of the following forms:
		- Experience in **sales operations or fixed operations at a heavy\-duty truck or trailer dealership** (e.g., sales management, F\&I, parts or service); **or**
		- Experience **supporting or implementing enterprise\-level software to heavy duty dealers**, such as a CRM, dealer management system (DMS) or inventory or comparable dealership technology.
	+ Familiarity with how dealerships manage leads, customer records, and follow\-up processes, and the ability to translate those processes into software configuration and workflows.
	+ Working knowledge of how a heavy\-duty dealership operates \- unit inventory, spec’ing and configuring customer purchases, parts and service revenue, and the relationship between dealership sales and fixed operations.
	+ Proven track record of conducting needs assessments, identifying operational gaps, configuring software to meet business requirements, and driving software adoption.
	+ Experience delivering effective training to groups and individuals, both remotely and on site.
	+ A continuous\-improvement mindset, with the ability to spot inefficiencies and make practical, well\-supported process and product recommendations.
	+ Strong organizational and project management skills, and the ability to coordinate cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
	+ Strong verbal, presentation, and written communication skills to effectively engage and influence customers both remotely and on site.
	+ Ability to learn a technical product \- including configuration, data imports, and integrations \- and clearly explain its value to non\-technical dealership customers.
	+ Excellent relationship\-building and consultative skills, with a proactive and resourceful approach.
	+ Proficiency in CRM systems, MS Suite or Google Suite, project management tools, and other CRM products. Additionally, the ability to report and present using digital presentation software.
	+ Highly motivated, professional, positive attitude, and thrives in a customer and team\-oriented environment.

**We are proud to** **offer:**
==============================

* + A competitive compensation structure pairing a base salary with an incentive plan tied directly to **On\-Time Implementation**, **Customer Satisfaction**, and **Platform** **Utilization**.
	+ Monday\-Friday work week.
	+ Excellent medical, dental, 401k and complimentary life insurance.
	+ Employee\-paid options on voluntary vision, LTD and FSA coverage.
	+ Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays.
